svg.text: FID = col*10 + row. Start top-left (FID 0), overshoot terminal top-right (FID 90/91, straight not corner). Purple outlines = corner (turn) cells.
Reward / Target Zone - T8, cols 7-8 rows 0-1 (FIDs 70,71,80,81)
Overshoot - everything after the reward zone: cols 8-9
Corner (turn) cells - 2x2 turn blocks incl. reward zone (NOT the overshoot terminal, FIDs 90/91, which is straight)
Traced path with turn markers T1-T9
